identity.title: Detection of Dimethyl Ether in the Central Region of the MWC 480 Protoplanetary Disk

paper_type_evidence.quote: We report a detection of dimethyl ether (CH$_3$OCH$_3$) in the disk around the Herbig Ae star MWC 480 with the sensitive Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array observations.

question.value: Are sublimated complex organic molecules (CH3OCH3, CH3OCHO, CH3OH) present in the inner warm region of the full (non-transitional) MWC 480 Herbig Ae disk, and what are their excitation conditions and abundance ratios?

evidence.quote: In this paper, we present the first detection of CH$_3$OCH$_3$ in the MWC 480 protoplanetary disk.
We observed the MWC 480 disk in Band 7 during ALMA Cycle 8 (project code: 2021.1.00535.S; PI: Y. Yamato).
We also used the Band 7 data from another project (project code: 2021.1.00982.S; PI: V. V. Guzman).
We observed the MWC 480 disk in Band 7 during ALMA Cycle 8
which covered a frequency range of 298.88–300.75 GHz and had a spectral resolution of 1.1 MHz (${\approx}1.1$ km s$^{-1}$)
covered a frequency range of 288.56–290.43 GHz with a spectral resolution of 1.1 MHz
This feature is a blend of 12 individual CH$_3$OCH$_3$ transitions
two tentative features are seen at ${\sim}299.12$ GHz and ${\sim}300.06$ GHz
the undetected CH$_3$OH transitions at 290.0–290.4 GHz
The CLEANed image cube has a synthesized beam of $0.31\ensuremath{''}\times0.21\ensuremath{''}$ (PA $=8.2\ensuremath{^\circ}$)

method.value: Spatially integrate cube in 0.6 arcsec diameter circular aperture at disk center; moment maps with bettermoments without flux threshold

evidence.quote: extracted the integrated spectra by spatially integrating the image cubes in a circular aperture with 0.6$''$ diameter toward the disk center

method.value: Cross-correlate visibilities with Keplerian kernel (i=37 deg, PA=148 deg, M=2.1 Msun, outer radius 0.15 arcsec)

evidence.quote: assuming a disk inclination angle of $37.0\ensuremath{^\circ}$, position angle of $148.0\ensuremath{^\circ}$ and central stellar mass of $2.1\,M_\odot$

validation.value: Cross-check of detections: ~17 sigma for the 299.89 GHz cluster, no ≥5 sigma for CH3OH/CH3CHO

evidence.quote: The response spectra do not exhibit any ${\ge}5\sigma$ responses of CH$_3$OH and CH$_3$CHO transitions.

analysis_steps.goal: Fit LTE slab model for Tex, line width, column densities

method.value: Simultaneous 7-parameter LTE fit of four species with common Tex to all >600 transitions

evidence.quote: the entire spectra are modeled with a total of seven free parameters
We run 50 walkers for 10000 steps to sample the posterior distributions and the initial 2000 steps are discarded as burn-in.

assumptions.value: Common Tex for all species, optically thin, Gaussian line shape, Tcmb=2.73 K

evidence.quote: The assumption of a common excitation temperature for all COM species reflects the expectation that different COMs sublimate simultaneously with water ice.

fitting.value: emcee affine-invariant MCMC; uniform priors Tex U(5,1000) K, dV U(0,100) km/s, vsys U(-5,15) km/s, log10 N U(10,20); upper limits at 99.85th percentile

evidence.quote: using uniform prior distributions

validation.value: Best-fit model compared with observed spectra

evidence.quote: The three observed spectral features are well reproduced by the best-fit model.

analysis_steps.goal: Radiative transfer test of spatial distribution

method.value: RADMC-3D image cubes from Zhang2021 disk structure with COMs set above sublimation temperatures (80/100 K for CH3OCH3; 100/120/140 K for CH3OH), z/r<0.3, Keplerian rotation; abundances adjusted to fit

evidence.quote: The abundance $x$(CH$_3$OCH$_3$) and $x$(CH$_3$OH) are adjusted to fit the observed spectra.

assumptions.value: Gas temperature = dust temperature; constant abundance in regions above sublimation temperature

findings_qualitative.value: CH3OCH3 emission is spatially unresolved and compact (≲25 au), consistent with sublimation in the warm inner disk

evidence.quote: The spatially unresolved, compact (${\lesssim}25$ au in radius) nature, the broad line width (${\sim}30$ km s$^{-1}$), and the high excitation temperature (${\sim}200$ K) indicate sublimation of COMs in the warm inner disk.

findings_qualitative.value: A new submillimeter source detected ~5.2 arcsec from the star, origin unclear

evidence.loc: Detection of a new submillimeter source
evidence.quote: We report the detection of a new submillimeter source at a separation of ${\approx}5.2\ensuremath{''}$ from the central star

claims.hypothesis: Sublimated COMs are detectable in a full (non-transitional) Class II disk
claims.experiment: Band 7 ALMA spectra at the MWC 480 disk center, matched filter and LTE fit
claims.result: CH3OCH3 detected (peak S/N 9.4; ~17 sigma matched filter); CH3OCHO tentative
claims.finding: First detection of CH3OCH3 in a non-transitional Class II disk, from inner-disk ice sublimation

evidence.quote: This is the first detection of CH$_3$OCH$_3$ in a non-transitional Class II disk.

claims.hypothesis: CH3OH should accompany CH3OCH3 if COMs are sublimated inherited ice
claims.experiment: Simultaneous LTE fit including CH3OH covered in 2021.1.00982.S
claims.finding: High ratio suggests disk-phase reprocessing and/or distribution differences

evidence.quote: we constrain the column density ratio of CH$_3$OCH$_3$/CH$_3$OH${\gtrsim}7$

claims.hypothesis: Differing sublimation radii of CH3OH and CH3OCH3 could explain the CH3OH non-detection
claims.result: Abundance ratio lower limits ~0.3–2, factor 3–20 below column ratio
claims.finding: Spatial distribution is critical for the true abundance ratio

evidence.quote: This indicates that the spatial distribution is a critical factor in measuring the correct abundance ratio.

claims.hypothesis: COM ratios differ between full and transition disks
claims.experiment: Compare ratios with HD 100546 and IRS 48 from literature
claims.finding: Suggests more reprocessing in inner full disk versus inherited ice at transition-disk cavity edges

evidence.quote: The abundance ratios exhibit a considerable degree of variability among the sources, with particularly elevated values in the full disk of MWC 480.

why_this_method.value: Large 4 km/s channels to boost S/N while resolving the broad line

evidence.quote: The large channel width of 4 km s$^{-1}$ intended to boost the S/N of detected CH$_3$OCH$_3$ emission while resolving its broad line width.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Exhaustive search found only CH3OCH3 and CH3OCHO could consistently explain the features

evidence.quote: only CH$_3$OCH$_3$ and CH$_3$OCHO can consistently explain these features among the lines of detectable species/transitions in typical disk environment

limitations_admitted.value: No detailed line shape modeling due to unresolved emission, low S/N and low spectral resolution

evidence.quote: given the unresolved emission, the low S/N, and the low spectral resolution, we do not perform a detailed line shape modeling here

limitations_admitted.value: Inner disk structure is an extrapolation of the outer disk

evidence.quote: the disk physical structure used in this modeling is an extrapolation of the outer disk structure

limitations_admitted.value: Flux calibration systematic uncertainty not included

evidence.quote: The following analyses consider only the statistical uncertainty and does not include the systematic flux calibration uncertainty.

referee_caveats_inferred: Detection rests on a single blended cluster; other features only tentative
Common Tex and optically thin slab assumptions with unresolved emission; beam dilution/filling factor degeneracy
CH3OH and CH3OCH3 constrained from different datasets with different noise and calibration
Dust continuum optical depth could hide CH3OH
Disk model gas temperature taken equal to dust temperature
